broken.json is invalid because it ends the object with a trailing comma: the file holds `{"retries": 3,}` (15 bytes plus a newline), and a comma is only legal there if another member follows. jq confirms this with a parse error at line 1, column 15. There is no valid parsed value to report — the only reading, an object with retries = 3, is what the author probably meant, not what the bytes say.

The notes folder holds two one-line notes on a single theme: how to run a retry policy. Both files open with the same phrase, "Retry policy", and split the concern into two halves — bounding the retries (cap attempts, back off, per notes/a.txt) and making them visible (log every attempt and surface the final failure, per notes/b.txt). Read together they describe one governing rule for retrying a failed operation: limit how many times you try and wait longer each time, while keeping an audit trail and reporting the last error instead of hiding it. With only these two short lines, the summary covers the full content of the folder — nothing else is in it.
